name: rat-king
description: Encrypted AT Protocol agent network and the tools to configure and run it.

scripts.check: pnpm lexgen:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:ship-confidence && ultracite check && oxfmt --check .
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/lexgen/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/alchemy-nest/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p stacks/cf/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/envelope/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mailbox/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/agent-runtime/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/claude-sidecar/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/claude-sidecar/test/worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: ALCHEMY_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 vitest run && vitest run --config tools/lexgen/vitest.config.ts && ALCHEMY_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 vitest run --config packages/alchemy-nest/vitest.config.ts && ALCHEMY_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 vitest run --config stacks/cf/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/envelope/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config apps/mailbox/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/agent-runtime/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config apps/claude-sidecar/vitest.config.ts
